target_customer: Plumbing, HVAC and other trades companies running 100+ jobs a day on ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro or Jobber
problem: Dispatchers assign jobs by gut feel while the best technician can generate far more revenue than average. Fleety listens to calls and routes each job to the technician most likely to produce the most revenue.
business_model: B2B SaaS for home service shops; pricing not found
product_category: AI dispatch software for home services

founders.name: Ben Zhou
previous_startups: Timrep, contractor permitting startup, six figure revenue, raised $540K (outcome not found)

founders.name: Ariyaman Molanorouzi
previous_startups: Ciel PM, property management automation for 3,000+ units (outcome not found)
SEO startup grown to six figure ARR (per founder Q&A)

technical_complexity.rationale: Call transcription plus a routing model over technician skill, location and close rate, with integrations into several field service systems; standard AI engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and revenue-per-technician data could accumulate, but a funded competitor and the underlying platforms can copy dispatch features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platforms and well funded rivals like Probook were already building AI dispatch by mid 2026. No later outcome known.

market_need_then: The company cites a customer doing about 92 percent of job assignments with Fleety and saving roughly $60K a year; private equity roll-ups of trades shops were growing quickly per Probook coverage.

branding.domain_note: Uses usefleety.com, a prefixed domain, suggesting fleety.com was unavailable; not confirmed by a source

identity.voice_and_tone: Revenue focused: Dispatch is where revenue is won.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly short name but easily confused with Fleetyr, Fleetline and fleet software in searches; no press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Fleety is a Fall 2026 YC company founded by former dispatchers who have also run adjacent startups, giving domain insight. It competes with a well funded dispatch rival and the platforms it integrates with. No outcome news and no verified funding were found.
notes: No funding source found; searches returned unrelated companies (Fleetyr, Fleetline). Legal entity shown as ProQueue, Inc. on the website footer. Founded year and founder education not stated. Customer results are company claims.
